info.desc: "Off the Wall" is the fifth studio album by the American recording artist Michael Jackson, released August 10, 1979 on Epic Records, after Jackson's critically well received film performance in The Wiz. While working on that project, Jackson and Quincy Jones had become friends, and Jones agreed to work with Jackson on his next studio album. Recording sessions took place between December 1978 and June 1979 at Allen Zentz Recording, Westlake Recording Studios, and Cherokee Studios in Los Angeles, California. Jackson collaborated with a number of other writers and performers such as Paul McCartney, Stevie Wonder and Rod Temperton. Five .

podcast.body: By 1979, with the release of *Off the Wall*, Michael Jackson was considered at his professional peak, having achieved an absolute sales record, scored five singles from a single album, and received maximum critical acclaim in nearly all major magazines. He was practically regarded as "the king of music," and this album was widely seen as his professional ceiling. "En 1979, Michael Jackson se acaba of the wall y ya no había conseguido todo, ya era su techo profesional."
